Resolve a Download URL via CKAN package_search

Source: R/lib_data_loader.R
rslvckns.Rd

The fallback for rslvckan() when a dataset's slug has changed and package_show no longer finds it. It runs a full-text package_search on the same CKAN portal and returns the URL of the first resource, across all datasets returned, whose name matches the pinned pattern.

Usage

rslvckns(prov)

Arguments

prov

A provenance list as returned by loadprov(), or NULL. The fields read are dataset$ckan_api_endpoint, resource$name_match_pattern (a regular expression, required for a match), and, both optional, resource$search_query (search words) and resource$format (a format name such as "XLSX").

Value

The matched resource URL as a length-1 character string, or NULL.

Details

The portal base is the part of dataset$ckan_api_endpoint before /api/3/; the request goes to <base>/api/3/action/ followed by package_search?q=<query>.

The query is resource$search_query when given, otherwise the resource$name_match_pattern with every character other than a letter, digit or space replaced by a space. Datasets are walked in the order CKAN ranks them, and their resources in listed order. A resource is taken when its name matches resource$name_match_pattern (case-insensitively) and either its format is CSV, or resource$format is unset, or its format equals resource$format (case-insensitively). So a CSV resource is accepted even when resource$format asks for another format.

NULL is returned when prov is NULL, when no query can be formed, when there is no endpoint to derive the base from, when the request fails, or when nothing matches. Errors: a prov that is not a list; a search URL or matched resource URL that is not public https. One network request.

Examples

# Missing fields return NULL rather than erroring:
rslvckns(list())
#> NULL

# no endpoint to derive the portal from: NULL, no request made
rslvckns(list(resource = list(name_match_pattern = "2014")))
#> NULL

# a provenance must be a list
try(rslvckns("data.ontario.ca"))
#> Error : rslvckns: `prov` must be a provenance list (loadprov())
if (FALSE) { # interactive()
# needs the network: searches data.ontario.ca
prov <- list(
  dataset = list(ckan_api_endpoint = paste0(
    "https://data.ontario.ca/api/3/action/package_show",
    "?id=ontario-public-library-statistics"
  )),
  resource = list(
    name_match_pattern = "2014",
    search_query = "public library statistics"
  )
)
rslvckns(prov)
}
